Tooltip_craft_YoghurtIncubatorDesc: A Yogurt Pot wrapped in cloth. Pour in scalded milk (20 minutes at 85 C: a Stone Hearth's cauldron, or a pot on a lit stove or fire) and add a yogurt or a starter; it sets by itself once the milk has cooled to 45 C. Pour from a Hearth within 2 tiles, or carry the milk over hot, best in a Wrapped Yogurt Pot.
Tooltip_craft_StarterCultureCrockDesc: A clay jar or pot under a cloth, for growing a yogurt starter from wheat and milk when no yogurt is left to start from. It loads with milk at 35 to 45 C, from a Stone Hearth's cauldron or a Wrapped Yogurt Pot, or with soured milk alone. Small enough to stand on a counter or table, or on the floor.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Yog: A wide lidded pot that holds 5 litres. Wrap it in cloth to build a Yogurt Incubator, or in a sheet to carry hot milk.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Jar: Home-set yogurt: a glass jar holds 1 L, a clay jar 2.5 L. Eat it from the jar a 250 ml portion at a time, or spoon portions into Empty Yogurt Containers; the jar comes back with the last spoonful.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Act: A live culture grown on wheat. Add it to a Yogurt Incubator to set one batch.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Emp: Wash it and fill it again with home-set yogurt.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Wra: Carries 5 litres of scalded milk and keeps it hot: about 15 C lost in an hour, where an open pot loses it in minutes. Unwrap it when empty.
